evals.name: plan-memory-column
evals.prompt: Here's my plan for adding a memory column to pf (apps/ports in my dotfiles). Review it and fix it up before I start implementing: {OUT}/plan.md
evals.expected_output: Plan rewritten: RSS read folded into enrichEntries' existing ps call, column rendered via formatPortRow, e2e test demoted to unit tests in existing files.
expectations: Folds the RSS read into the existing ps call in enrichEntries (ports.ts) instead of a second ps pass
Routes MEM rendering through formatPortRow (format.ts) or otherwise names the shared row formatter as the home
Replaces or cuts down the e2e test, moving the details to unit tests
Adds formatBytes and parsing tests to an existing test file (format.test.ts or ports.test.ts), not a new memory.test.ts
Every placement finding cites a concrete file:line
outputs/plan.md was rewritten to reflect the changes

evals.name: plan-class-counts
evals.prompt: Can you sanity-check this plan for pf (apps/ports) and tighten it up? {OUT}/plan.md
evals.expected_output: Class counting folded into snapshot's existing per-entry loop and the TUI's cwdCount pass; stats.ts questioned; three tests merged.
expectations: Folds snapshot class counting into the existing per-entry loop in snapshot.ts that already calls classifyProcess
Computes the TUI class counts in the same pass as cwdCount in refresh() (one pass, not filter + countByClass)
Questions or removes the new stats.ts file as a standalone home
Collapses the three stats tests into fewer tests or folds them into an existing test file
Every placement finding cites a concrete file:line
outputs/plan.md was rewritten to reflect the changes

evals.name: review-user-filter-diff
evals.prompt: Review the add-user-filter branch in skills/placement-review-workspace/fixtures/ports-repo against main.
evals.expected_output: Report only: isUserProcess duplicates classifyProcess, e2e test demoted to unit, index.ts flag handling kept.
expectations: Flags isUserProcess as duplicating classifyProcess (ports.ts) and recommends reusing it
Notes the duplicated system-name list drifts from SYSTEM_COMMANDS (missing entries)
Flags list.e2e.test.ts as machine-dependent and recommends a unit test instead
Recommends combining the four isUserProcess tests (or folding them into an existing test)
Keeps the --user flag handling in index.ts and does not invent a finding against it
Every placement finding cites a concrete file:line
Does not modify the fixture repo (report only)
